development_stages: fit every candidate pipeline on training windows only
rank candidates and feature sets using validation labels only
freeze exactly one classifier, variant, and feature set
clone and refit the frozen pipeline on combined training and validation windows
predict the test set exactly once
report the frozen test result without reopening selection

pipeline_rules.median_imputation: fit inside each pipeline using its current fitting partition only
pipeline_rules.standardization: fit inside scale-sensitive pipelines using its current fitting partition only

random_window_role: diagnostic comparator using a separately frozen manifest
